entries.name: OpenAI Codex
entries.supported_claim: Hierarchical repository instruction files discovered by Codex.
entries.best_use: Durable repository commands and scoped directory rules.
entries.important_boundary: Discovery order and override behavior in the installed Codex version.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot
entries.supported_claim: Repository-wide and path-specific instruction mechanisms documented by GitHub.
entries.important_boundary: Which Copilot surface consumes each instruction type.

entries.name: Claude Code
entries.supported_claim: Hierarchical memory/instruction files and imports documented by Anthropic.
entries.important_boundary: Import availability, scope, and precedence for the current release.

entries.name: Cursor
entries.supported_claim: Project rules stored in the repository with rule metadata.
entries.important_boundary: Legacy rule migration and rule activation conditions.

entries.name: Windsurf
entries.supported_claim: Workspace rules and memory behavior documented by Windsurf.
entries.best_use: Stable workspace conventions in the supported rule format.
entries.important_boundary: Local/global memory interactions and size limits.

entries.name: Aider
entries.supported_claim: A configured text file is added to the coding context as conventions.
entries.best_use: A concise adapter generated from canonical project rules.
entries.important_boundary: Context cost and whether instructions are actually followed.

entries.name: Continue
entries.supported_claim: Rules customize agent/chat behavior in Continue.
entries.important_boundary: Rule format and applicability in the installed Continue version.

entries.name: Cline
entries.supported_claim: Repository and user rules documented for Cline.
entries.important_boundary: Precedence and behavior across Cline modes/releases.

field_provenance.supported_claim: source-backed at the cited URL, subject to the recorded review date/version
field_provenance.important_boundary: author analysis unless the linked source explicitly states it
